scope: PoE 1 current regular/non-Foulborn, non-legacy, non-Ruthless item versions from live Wiki item cards. Exact version evidence per item is recorded when the page provides it; Wiki revisions are not game version identifiers. No media downloaded.

items.name: Headhunter
explicitStats: (20-30)% increased Damage with Hits against Rare monsters
When you Kill a Rare monster, you gain its Modifiers for 60 seconds

mechanics.modifierScope: All explicit modifiers of the killed rare monster
mechanics.duplicateModifierRefreshRule: Not independently verified in this research; do not infer refresh rules from non-stacking.

items.versionEvidence: Wiki Version history explicitly records 3.18.0e: stolen-modifier duration changed from 20 to 60 seconds, including existing versions.
items.adaptationBoundary: Requires actual rare monster modifiers and timed stolen instances. A fixed generic buff after elite kills is an adaptation of its signature mechanic, not original modifier transfer.

items.name: Death Rush
explicitStats: Gain Adrenaline for (1-3) seconds on Kill

mechanics.twoCopyRule: Durations from equivalent item stats add. Buff magnitude does not double.

items.versionEvidence: Wiki Version history records 3.19.0 replacement of the old modifiers with Life recovery and Adrenaline. Old Onslaught and leech lines are legacy.
items.adaptationBoundary: Adrenaline cannot have its timer reset on every kill. Life-on-kill recovery is a separate modifier. Do not use old Onslaught or physical-attack leech lines.

items.name: Dying Sun
explicitStats: (10-20)% increased Area of Effect during Effect
Skills fire 2 additional Projectiles during Effect

mechanics.durationRule: less Duration is multiplicative with quality and other relevant duration modifiers; displayed range here is the zero-quality default item.
mechanics.effectScalingExample: Wiki explicitly states 50% increased Flask Effect raises 2 extra projectiles to 3.

items.versionEvidence: Wiki Version history: 3.15.0 changed area to 10-20% and charges used to 125-150%; 3.16.0 changed reduced Duration to less Duration. Current main item card/Ruby Flask tooltip provide the 8-second base and 40%/+5% Fire Resistance stats; old base-flask history entries are not current values.

observedDuskboundAdaptation.note: Snapshot inspected during research: unconditional equipment modifiers, not timed charged flask effects. +1 projectile differs from original +2. 20% area is one legal roll but currently permanent.

items.adaptationBoundary: A permanent projectile/area item omits flask activation, duration, charges, resistance stats, and flask-effect scaling. Keep labelled adaptation.

items.name: Cloak of Flame
explicitStats: Reflects 100 Fire Damage to Melee Attackers
40% of Physical Damage taken as Fire Damage

mechanics.damageTakenAsRule: Changes the damage type of that portion before mitigation. It is not unconditional reduced Damage taken. Applies to physical hits and physical DoT such as Bleed/Corrupted Blood.

items.versionEvidence: Wiki Version history: 3.19.0 replaced 20% Physical Damage from Hits taken as Fire with 40% Physical Damage taken as Fire, removed 10% chance to Ignite, increased resistance/duration rolls and reflection to current values.

observedDuskboundAdaptation.note: Snapshot inspected during research. None of these three modifiers are the current unique explicit mods.

items.adaptationBoundary: Original has no explicit +35 maximum Life, 0.7 regeneration or 15% generic reduction. A real implementation needs damage types and damage-taken-as processing.

items.name: Nebulis
explicitStats: (6-8)% increased Elemental Damage per 1% Fire, Cold, or Lightning Resistance above 75%

mechanics.resistanceInputs: Actual capped Fire, Cold, and Lightning Resistance, not uncapped/overcapped values.
mechanics.formulaForUniqueExplicitElementalDamageI: roll * (max(0, cappedFireResistance - 75) + max(0, cappedColdResistance - 75) + max(0, cappedLightningResistance - 75))

items.versionEvidence: Wiki Version history explicitly records 3.29.0: 6-8% per resistance point (previously 5-10%). 3.27.0 changed old separate 15-20% Cold/Lightning scaling to all-element scaling and added 60-120% implicit magnitudes.

observedDuskboundAdaptation.note: Snapshot inspected during research. Constant generic damage differs from cast speed, synthesis implicit scaling and capped-resistance-dependent Elemental Damage.

items.adaptationBoundary: Do not copy the old 15-20% Cold/Lightning lines from the separate fractured item card or legacy section. Three synthesis implicits replace the normal 40% increased Elemental Damage base implicit; exact implicit choices are variable.

stats: 25% increased Attack, Cast, and Movement Speed
adrenaline.versionEvidence: Wiki history records 3.19.0: cannot be gained while already active.

verification: All listed original item stat lines checked against fetched HTML visible text. Source revisions and SHA-256 recorded. Production gameplay not modified or tested.
